question: In March 2023, who took charge as the 28th Controller General of Accounts (CGA) of Ministry of Finance of the Government of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**S.S Dubey**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• S.S Dubey took charge as the 28th Controller General of Accounts (CGA) of the Ministry of Finance, Government of India in March 2023.
 
• The CGA is the principal advisor to the Government of India on accounting matters and responsible for establishing and maintaining a technically sound management accounting system.
 
• The CGA's office was set up in 1976 under the Department of Expenditure, Ministry of Finance.
 
• The CGA oversees the payment and accounting system for the Government of India and prepares the annual accounts of the central government.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Controller General of Accounts (CGA)**

 
 
• The CGA is a part of the Indian Civil Accounts Service (ICAS).
 
• The CGA is responsible for the compilation and consolidation of the government accounts and is responsible for the preparation of a critical report named the 'Union Government Finance Accounts'.
 
• The CGA is the head of the Indian Civil Accounts Organisation, which functions through the Principal Accounts Office of various ministries and departments.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Finance**
 
 
• The Ministry of Finance is a critical ministry within the Government of India, responsible for managing the economy, financial resources, and revenue collection.
 
• It oversees the financial institutions and markets, including the Reserve Bank of India (RBI).
 
• The ministry is divided into five departments: Economic Affairs, Expenditure, Revenue, Financial Services, and Investment and Public Asset Management.
 
 
 
• **Indian Civil Accounts Service (ICAS)**
 
 
• ICAS is a central civil service under the Department of Expenditure in the Ministry of Finance.
 
• The service was constituted in 1976 following the separation of accounts from audit.
 
• The primary responsibility of ICAS officers is to maintain the accounting and financial management system for the Government of India.
